column6: Jump. In the air, this also opens the paraglider.
Run while the button is held. It also makes Link swim and climb faster.
Swing your weapon. Hold the button and then release it for a charged attack.
Talk, pick things up, open things, and every other field action that the game shows an A prompt for.
Put away what Link is holding, or back out of aiming or building. On the Switch, this shares the B button with Sprint.
The game’s X button has a second field action besides Jump. This action stays on X even when the game’s own option moves Jump to B.
Hold to open the ability wheel. Press to use the selected ability.
Hold to get ready to throw your weapon, then let go to throw it.
Hold to raise your shield and lock on to a target.
Draw your bow. Press Attack to shoot.
Opens the game’s quick menu for D-pad up.
Whistles for your horse, as D-pad down does in the game.
Opens the game’s quick menu for D-pad left.
Opens the game’s quick menu for D-pad right.
